examples.ar: الصَّدِيقُ المُلْصِقُ يَقِفُ مَعَكَ فِي الرَّخَاءِ وَالشِّدَّةِ.
examples.en: The loyal friend stands with you in ease and hardship.

examples.ar: وَالَّذِي جَاءَ بِالصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِ ۙ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُونَ.
examples.en: And the one who has brought the truth and believed in it - those are the righteous.
Indeed, God is with the patient.

examples.ar: الصَّبْرُ مِفْتَاحُ الفَرَجِ بَعْدَ كُلِّ عُسْرٍ.
examples.en: Patience is the key to relief after every hardship.

examples.ar: كَانَ صَوْتُ القَارِئِ عَذْبًا وَمُؤَثِّرًا فِي النُّفُوسِ.
examples.en: The reciter's voice was sweet and moving to the souls.

examples.ar: الْتَّعْلِيمُ وَالصِّحَّةُ هُمَا أَسَاسُ التَّنْمِيَةِ البَشَرِيَّةِ.
examples.en: Education and health are the foundations of human development.

examples.ar: إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ كَانَتْ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ كِتَابًا مَّوْقُوتًا.
examples.en: Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers at specified times.
The software industry is witnessing a tremendous development.
